# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Titles:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>; master  <sub>[v1 c15 P12](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0012)</sub>; schoolmaster  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>; educator  <sub>[v1 c17 P18](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0018)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Pidgeon twirls his mustache while teaching at Brierley school.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

Mr. Pidgeon exhibits a sarcastic and overbearing manner with his students when enforcing discipline. He is prone to favoritism, spending much of his time attending to older female students while ignoring younger pupils. Though strict and harsh at times, he is capable of showing emotion, weeping during his farewell speech to his class.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Mr. Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster of Brierley school, securing the position largely because his uncle was a primary school trustee. During his tenure, he spent the majority of his effort focusing on older pupils preparing for Regent's, while showing romantic interest in student Sukey Pullen. He was known for making sarcastic remarks and handing out punishments, such as forcing Nell Harcourt to stand by the blackboard for breaking a slate over Hugh Carrow's head, or making her sit next to Hugh after she ran into class late. He also participated in the local Debating Club concert, giving an emotional recitation of Mark Antony's address. After the school year ended, he delivered an emotional farewell speech to his pupils and departed Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_
